description: This is a Java test class named 'JournalEntryReversalOrderingIntegrationTest' used for testing journal entry reversal ordering within the Apache Fineract project. It involves creating accounts, applying for a loan, making a repayment, reversing the transaction, and verifying the correct ordering of journal entries after reversal.

classes.name: JournalEntryReversalOrderingIntegrationTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for verifying the correct ordering of journal entries after a transaction reversal in the Fineract accounting system.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes REST-assured specifications and helper objects before each test run.

methods.name: testJournalEntryReversalOrdering
methods.description: Main test method that sets up accounts and loans, makes a repayment, reverses it, and verifies journal entry ordering.

methods.name: verifyJournalEntriesOrdering
methods.description: Validates that journal entries are ordered by transaction date ascending, then created date ascending, then ID descending.

methods.name: extractDateString
methods.description: Extracts a date string from a journal entry attribute, handling different data formats.

methods.name: createLoanProductWithAccounting
methods.description: Creates a loan product with specified accounting rules and accounts.

methods.name: applyForLoanApplication
methods.description: Creates and submits a loan application with specified parameters.
